description: Source code for the SampleIterator class in the Android media framework, handling MP4 sample parsing and seeking.

classes.name: SampleIterator
classes.description: Iterator class for traversing MP4 sample data within a SampleTable.

methods.name: SampleIterator::reset
methods.description: Resets internal state variables for sample iteration.

methods.name: SampleIterator::seekTo
methods.description: Seeks to a specific sample index within the sample table.

methods.name: SampleIterator::findChunkRange
methods.description: Finds the chunk range that contains the specified sample index.

methods.name: SampleIterator::getChunkOffset
methods.description: Retrieves the byte offset of a specified chunk.

methods.name: SampleIterator::getSampleSizeDirect
methods.description: Gets the size of a sample directly from the sample table data.

methods.name: SampleIterator::findSampleTimeAndDuration
methods.description: Calculates the presentation time and duration for a sample.
